precedence: This exact actor closure and exact authenticated composer rule narrow protocol001 T02/T06/T07/open_Source_proof_contract and its N19 coverage; every other limit/hold stays unchanged. Existing files are preserved.
validation_order: Validate the eager supplied record store, strict closed schema/type/required pin identities and actor slot syntax for expected values, all45 selection rows, every original request/publication row, every corresponding receipt/facts/provenance, and both known code APIs. These are untrusted recorded values; successful content proof is still required afterward.

Collect the complete exclusion union below in one immutable local snapshot BEFORE evaluating ANY Source capsule/full-proof reviewer, including code, selection, catalogue, stage-purpose, draft, canonical delta or reconciliation proofs. Pure eager bytes permit this two-pass collection without IO or permission. Never derive exclusions lazily from only the selected row or only after code review.

All later typed joins remain mandatory; a mismatch refuses even if its actor merely broadened exclusions. No successfully reviewed record can shrink or replace the derived union. expected.actual_content_authors is additive only, never a coverage attestation or authority token.

For each reviewer, enforce the immutable union plus that proof context additional excluded actors and subtrees. Neither a caller list, a serialized view, an API flag nor an empty author list can override this rule.

actor_syntax_and_comparison: A mandatory actor slot requires exact builtin str equal /root or matching /root(?:/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)+ with length<=512; source_editor, producer/publisher editors, content authors and proof reviewers must be nonRoot descendants. Null, whitespace, trailing slash, double slash, dot/dotdot or other alias syntax refuses without normalization.

Preserve original actor strings in evidence/results. Compute a separate casefold comparison key for exclusions only. Reviewer refuses if key equals any excluded actor key, or starts with excluded_nonRoot_key plus slash. /root itself is excluded by equality only: do not exclude every legitimate /root/descendant merely because Root is in the union.

Use the same exclusion keys for capsule and full proof; their recorded reviewer strings must also be exactly equal. Case variant equality/subtree cannot bypass the union. Multiple recorded slots with the identical actor string are allowed and union-deduplicated. Conflicting case variants within declared expected.actual_content_authors are refused as actor aliases.

Arbitrary pseudonymous identities or physical account equivalence cannot be established by this pure component; physical/human/caller/producer qualification remain false. This is a conservative recorded-actor separation check, not authentication.
